cues.title: State 1: Calibration & Optical CV Lock
cues.text: Welcome to VoltTwin AR v2.0 for Snap SPECS glasses. In State 1, real-time computer vision scans the room and locks onto Panel HV-402 with 99.4% confidence.

cues.title: State 2: Live Arc-Flash Hazard & 68°C Thermal Conduits
cues.text: State 2: A pulsing crimson hazard cage and 1-meter floor perimeter ring appear. Conduits glow amber-hot at 68 degrees Celsius.

cues.title: Proximity Warning & Plasma Arc Blast
cues.text: Warning! The proximity interlock detects the technician hand entering 15 centimeters. Watch the volumetric plasma spark burst and high-voltage acoustic discharge!

cues.title: State 3: Hands-Free Mechanical Isolation
cues.text: State 3: The technician issues hands-free speech command: Toggle B2. Breaker B2 isolates.

cues.title: 3D Exploded-View & Audio Occlusion Unmasking
cues.text: The technician says 'Explode View', expanding 3D cabinet modules outward. Notice spatial acoustic occlusion unmasking the raw 60 Hertz transformer hum from -12dB to full unattenuated volume.

cues.title: State 4: Gaze Dwell & Ghost Probe Zero-Energy Verification
cues.text: State 4: OSHA zero-energy verification. The technician locks head-gaze on Terminal T1 for 1.5 seconds. Translucent 3D ghost probes align at 45 degrees as voltage drops to zero point zero volts.

cues.title: State 5: Immutable Cryptographic Tagout & Audit Export
cues.text: State 5: Tagout complete! All perimeters turn emerald green, a glowing digital padlock snaps over the breaker, electrical hum is silenced, and cryptographic audit log LOTO-HASH-994A is automatically exported. Safe to work!
